svg.aria-label: How to write ൪ ൫: 2 letters, ൪, ൫, one after another
svg.title: Writing ൪ ൫
svg.desc: 2 letters written one after another: ൪, ൫ (malayalam). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansMalayalam-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: ൪: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൪; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൫: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൫; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>. Source notes on variation: ൪: Jayasree records ൪ as one stroke: up the left side and over the top, down through the crossing and round the bottom of the bowl, back up through the crossing, and on to the top (start lower left, end upper right). Manjari ends the stroke with a straight rise where Noto curls to the upper right; the order and turning are the same, so the path follows Noto's curl. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൫: Jayasree records ൫ as one stroke: up the small inner curve from its lower tip, round its top into the notch in the middle, back out and round the right bowl, along the bottom and up the outer left side, then over the top and down the right (start at the inner lower tip, end at the outer lower right). The turn out of the notch retraces a short stretch of ink. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium.
svg.text: How it is written — 2 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 2 — one unbroken stroke · 4 movements
Letter 2 of 2 — one unbroken stroke · 5 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57,
October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൪; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0
Letter 2: stroke order after Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57,
October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൫; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
